meanings.exampleEn: He unwillingly agreed to help with the chores.
meanings.exampleTr: Ev işlerine yardım etmeyi isteksizce kabul etti.

meanings.exampleEn: We drove along a twisting mountain road.
meanings.exampleTr: Virajlı bir dağ yolunda araba sürdük.

meanings.exampleEn: The meandering river wound through the valley.
meanings.exampleTr: Kıvrıla kıvrıla akan nehir vadiden geçiyordu.

meanings.en: to spread a substance over a surface untidily
meanings.exampleEn: She tried not to smear paint on her clothes.

meanings.en: to withdraw a statement or draw something back in
meanings.exampleEn: The newspaper had to retract its false claim.
meanings.exampleTr: Gazete yanlış iddiasını geri almak zorunda kaldı.

meanings.en: a person who is present but not involved in an event
meanings.exampleEn: An innocent bystander was injured in the accident.

meanings.en: lacking a sense of humor; serious
meanings.exampleEn: The teacher was strict and completely humorless.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen katı ve tamamen mizahtan yoksundu.

meanings.en: the act of carving wood by cutting small pieces from it
meanings.exampleEn: Whittling is a relaxing hobby for many woodworkers.
meanings.exampleTr: Yontma, birçok ağaç işçisi için rahatlatıcı bir hobidir.

meanings.en: old and torn; in poor condition
meanings.exampleEn: He wore a tattered coat full of holes.
meanings.exampleTr: Delik deşik, eski püskü bir palto giyiyordu.

meanings.exampleEn: The disease is spreading at an alarming rate.
meanings.exampleTr: Hastalık endişe verici bir hızla yayılıyor.

meanings.exampleEn: The report contained some troubling statistics.
meanings.exampleTr: Rapor bazı kaygı verici istatistikler içeriyordu.

meanings.exampleEn: His health began to deteriorate rapidly.

meanings.en: disrespectful speech about God or sacred things
meanings.exampleEn: In some countries, blasphemy is a serious crime.
meanings.exampleTr: Bazı ülkelerde kutsala hakaret ciddi bir suçtur.

meanings.exampleEn: The old coins turned out to be valueless.

meanings.en: an image produced on film by X-rays
meanings.exampleEn: The dentist examined the radiograph of my teeth.
meanings.exampleTr: Diş hekimi dişlerimin röntgen filmini inceledi.

meanings.en: a boat that is moved by sails
meanings.exampleEn: They spent the afternoon on a small sailboat.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğleden sonrayı küçük bir yelkenli teknede geçirdiler.

meanings.en: to have a strong desire for something
meanings.exampleEn: After the long hike, I craved a cold drink.
meanings.exampleTr: Uzun yürüyüşten sonra soğuk bir içeceğe can atıyordum.

meanings.en: a fastener with two rows of teeth joined by a sliding tab
meanings.exampleEn: The zipper on my jacket is broken.

meanings.en: a device that holds things together
meanings.exampleEn: This bag uses a magnetic fastener instead of a button.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu çanta düğme yerine manyetik bir kapama kullanıyor.
